name: Ralla Weralata Adarei
overview: Set against the backdrop of a coastal village, this gripping romance drama follows Sandeep, a young fisherman dreaming of a better life, and Nethmi, a wealthy girl he rescues from a near-fatal drowning. As a deep bond blossoms between them, they must fight against steep class divides, severe family opposition, and the harsh realities of the sea to protect their love.
